description: "On the Advisableness of Improving Natural Knowledge" by Thomas Henry Huxley is a philosophical discourse published in the mid-19th century, specifically during the Victorian era. This book serves as a lay sermon where Huxley expounds on the significance of advancing natural knowledge and understanding.
